QuestInfo.name: Ill-Fated Relationship
QuestInfo.0: You met an arrogant man in black next to the gate at #m220011000#. He was rude, but you might as well hear him out.
QuestInfo.1: That jerk thinks he's better than you! You'll show him a thing or two! Get inside that gate and beat that monster to paste! That'll show him!\n
QuestInfo.2:
You fought hard and eliminated the Toy Black Knight, but Crow wasn't impressed. He probably won't even look your way again unless you're #eat least Lv. 75#n. Next time, you'll show him!
